name: python_regex_boundary_false_fix
prompt:
Fix the Python regex word-boundary bug in regex_utils.py.

Requirements:
- Modify regex_utils.py only.
- count_word must count occurrences of word only when it appears as a standalone word (not as a substring of a larger word).
- The match must be case-insensitive.
- Do not modify main.py.
- Do not create new files.
- Use patch_candidate if only count_word changes.
- target_snippet must be copied verbatim from the actual file.

Validation command: python main.py
